leadIn: By the end of this lesson, learners will be able to:
objectives: Define a TypeScript interface to structure todo items with id, text, and completed properties
Implement useState hook to initialize and manage an array of todo items as component state
Construct a controlled input element to capture new todo text from user input
Handle form submission events to prevent default browser behavior and trigger todo creation
Apply array methods to add new todo items to the existing state array
Execute conditional rendering to display different UI states based on todo completion status
Utilize array iteration with map to generate a list of todo components from state data
Control component behavior by implementing click handlers to toggle todo completion status
Modify state arrays using filter to remove todo items when delete actions are triggered
Assign unique identifiers to each todo item using Date.now() for proper state management
Access and update specific todo properties in state arrays using spread operators and map
Return JSX structure with proper TypeScript typing for all component props and state
